_readme: The Sanity CMS (project 763y4e9t, dataset production) behind cherry.vc's 2024-03 to 2025 Next.js site, still publicly readable on 2026-09-04 through the query API (escalation ladder step 2): 86 company documents with name, slug, website, a date field (a bare year 'YYYY-01-01' for the pre-2024 book = the company's founding/launch year as the site rendered 'Founded in YYYY'; a day-precise date for companies added from 2024-09 on = the announcement date, read as invest_year), founders, sector tags and an 'Exit' tag. Documents were created at the 2024-03 migration (_createdAt) so they date this list surface to 2024-2025.
